sourceRefs.locator: 5.48.1–3: Jovius meets Alaric at Ariminum and sends demands including annual gold, grain and settlement to the emperor

note.de: Alarich besprach mit Jovius Geld, Versorgung und Siedlungsland. Jovius übermittelte die Forderungen nach Ravenna.
note.en: Alaric and Jovius discussed money, supplies and a place to settle. Jovius forwarded the demands to Ravenna.
